svg.title: 07 / Compare with context before committing to keys
svg.desc: Schema first, distribution next, row identity only after explicit user confirmation.. Design proposal, not a runtime screenshot. All dataset values and counts are synthetic illustrations. See README for capability boundaries and sources.
svg.text: 07 / Compare with context before committing to keys
Schema first, distribution next, row identity only after explicit user confirmation.
DESIGN GUIDANCE ONLY • synthetic data • no runtime changes • sources and acceptance notes in README.md
Rows 1–5 of 12 · logical row identity retained
B does not replace the main grid.
No row diff with empty keys.
Illustrative metrics; reports show exact counts and sample truncation separately.
1 Schema: added / removed / changed types and nullability
2 Distribution: null rates, numeric shifts and available categorical deltas
3 Rows: exact counts, bounded samples and changed-column lists
Only A-side logical rows can jump into the main grid.
B-only examples remain in comparison context.
Overlay edits mark results stale; rerun is explicit.
Never show a stale report as proof of the edited dataset.
Show available metrics with direction and scope.
Do not invent PSI / KS / arbitrary histogram evidence.
